scope: new lossless raw deduplication path plus emitter/refusal controls
findings: Certificate requires real cold n600 proof, exact live raw path/bytes/SHA matches, same-device custody and an owned candidate destination. Writes certificate before any replacement.
Only owned duplicate output is replaced; both raw paths remain reachable with equal inode after hardlink. Source archive/runtime/command and full public result are pinned in certificate.
No authorization/first-measurement call exists. Normal --seal runs unchanged and fails the control if any subprocess is attempted.
